deals.deal: Chipotle App: Order Online for Exclusive Digital Deals
deals.desc: Order through the free Chipotle app or Chipotle.com to access app-only pricing, promotions, and the Chipotle Rewards program (free account required); check the app's Offers tab for any live single-visit deals available in your market today.

deals.deal: Chick-fil-A App: Digital Exclusive Offers Tab
deals.desc: Open the free Chick-fil-A app, navigate to Offers, and browse any currently loaded digital coupons claimable in a single visit at participating locations (free Chick-fil-A One account required to view and claim).

deals.deal: BOGO 50% Off Footlong Sub with Code BOGO50
deals.desc: Use promo code BOGO50 at online or in-app checkout to get a second footlong sub at 50% off when you buy one at full price; check the app for current availability as this is a limited-time promotional code.

deals.deal: Pick Your Pair: Sandwich and More Starting at a Bundled Price
deals.desc: Potbelly's Pick-Your-Pair combo lets you mix and match a half sandwich with a soup, salad, or mac and cheese for bundled meal savings; order online or in-app for easiest access.

deals.deal: Smoothie and Flatbread Combo from $7.19 via App Order
deals.desc: Order a smoothie and flatbread combo through the Tropical Smoothie Cafe app for a complete meal starting around $7.19, representing strong everyday bundle value versus ordering items separately.

deals.deal: Smoothie King Healthy Rewards: Earn and Track in-App
deals.desc: Download the Smoothie King app to access current in-app offers, track Healthy Rewards points, and see any live promo codes active this week at participating locations nationwide.

deals.deal: Panera Soups and Salads Everyday Value Menu
deals.desc: Panera offers a rotating everyday menu of soups, salads, and sandwiches at stated prices with no promo code needed; order via the Panera app for easy pickup and to track any current limited-time offers on the Deals tab.

deals.deal: CAVA App: Build-Your-Own Bowl with Full Customization and Rewards
deals.desc: Order a custom Mediterranean grain bowl or salad through the CAVA app and earn rewards on every purchase; check the app's Deals section for any active limited-time promo offers today.

deals.deal: Sweetgreen App: Seasonal Salads and Bowl Ordering with Sweetpass Rewards
deals.desc: Order any seasonal salad or warm bowl through the Sweetgreen app, earn Sweetpass credits on every purchase, and check the Deals tab for any active promo codes or limited-time discounts in your market.

deals.deal: El Pollo Loco App: Fire-Grilled Chicken Deals and Digital Coupons
deals.desc: Download the El Pollo Loco app to browse current digital offers on flame-grilled chicken meals, burritos, and Fresca Salads including the new Citrus Avocado Fresca Salad available for a limited time.
deals.region: CA, AZ, TX, NV and select Western states

deals.deal: Chili’s 3 For Me: Starter, Entree, and Non-Alcoholic Drink from $10.99
deals.desc: Chili’s 3 For Me bundle includes an appetizer, a full entree, and a drink at a single stated price starting at $10.99 at participating locations; no promo code needed, just order in-restaurant or via the Chili’s app.

deals.deal: Wingstop Classic Bone-In Wings: 10 for $10, 20 for $20, 30 for $30
deals.desc: Wingstop offers straightforward bundle pricing on bone-in classic wings starting at 10 wings for $10; order direct on Wingstop.com or via the app to ensure promo pricing applies and avoid third-party markups.

deals.deal: Shake Shack App: ShackTrack Digital-Only Pricing and Offers
deals.desc: Order ahead on the Shake Shack app to access ShackTrack digital ordering and check the Rewards and Offers tab for any current limited-time promo deals at your nearest location.

deals.deal: Noodles and Company: Rewards App and Current Promo Code Offers
deals.desc: Download the Noodles app and check the Offers section for any active promo codes on pasta bowls and entrees; Noodles frequently runs limited-time percentage-off or flat-price deals through the app.

deals.deal: The Halal Guys App: Rewards and Digital Order Offers on Platters and Sandwiches
deals.desc: Order through The Halal Guys app to earn rewards on every platter or sandwich purchase and check the Deals tab for any active single-visit offers on fully halal-certified chicken and beef gyro combos.
